name: Gemini
description: Gemini integrates with Google Workspace but remains reactive. GAIA proactively manages your entire digital workflow across your tools, not just Google products.
metaTitle: Gemini vs GAIA: Google's AI or a Proactive Assistant
metaDescription: Gemini answers when you ask inside Google apps. GAIA acts first: it triages Gmail, manages tasks, and runs workflows. Compare pricing.
intro: Google Gemini brings AI capabilities to the Google ecosystem with integration into Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and more. It makes Google Workspace smarter with AI-powered suggestions, summaries, and content generation. But Gemini fundamentally enhances existing Google tools rather than orchestrating your entire workflow. GAIA connects all your tools, not just Google products, and acts proactively on your behalf.

rows.gaia: Proactive productivity OS that manages your entire digital workflow autonomously
rows.competitor: AI layer that enhances Google Workspace products with AI capabilities

rows.gaia: Deep integrations across all productivity tools (not just Google)
rows.competitor: Primarily Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet)

rows.gaia: Monitors and acts on your behalf 24/7 without being asked
rows.competitor: Provides suggestions and summaries when you interact with it

rows.gaia: Multi-step workflows with triggers, cross-tool orchestration, and autonomous execution
rows.competitor: No workflow automation; AI assistance within individual apps

rows.gaia: Graph-based memory connecting all your work across tools and time
rows.competitor: Context within individual Google products, limited cross-app memory

rows.gaia: AI-powered todos with automatic creation, prioritization, and execution
rows.competitor: Basic integration with Google Tasks, no autonomous management

rows.gaia: Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, Trello, and more
rows.competitor: Limited to Google ecosystem and select extensions

gaiaAdvantages: Works across all your tools, not limited to Google
Proactive automation that acts before you ask
Source-available with self-hosting for complete privacy
Graph-based memory that learns your work patterns
competitorAdvantages: Deep native integration with Google Workspace
Larger context window for document processing
Google Search integration for real-time information
verdict: Choose Gemini if your work lives primarily in Google Workspace and you want AI-enhanced productivity within those tools. Choose GAIA if you use tools beyond Google and want a proactive AI assistant that orchestrates your entire digital workflow autonomously.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Google services like Gemini does?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA integrates with Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Tasks, and Google Meet. Additionally, GAIA connects with non-Google tools like Slack, Notion, GitHub, and Linear that Gemini cannot access.

faqs.question: How does GAIA's pricing compare to Gemini's free tier?
faqs.answer: Gemini has a free tier with paid Google One AI Premium for advanced features. Hosted GAIA is a paid plan at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and self-hosting is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs) for total data control.
